title: 40-ton crane operated day rates (US)
notes: Operated = crane with certified operator unless noted.
Where sheets publish $/hour, day_rate_usd assumes an 8-hour regular shift (hourly × 8). That conversion is an ESTIMATE labeled on each row.
Portal-to-portal / travel both ways is typical; mobilization is NOT included in day_rate unless stated — enter a vendor quote in the UI.
Lee Nash figure is a modular SET package quote (not a day rate) kept as CRM reference only.
assumption_boxes_per_day_note: baseline 2 boxes (modules) set per crane day.

Southeast.source: Limehouse & Sons (Ladson, SC) web rate list — 40-ton Grove rough-terrain w/ operator $200/hr ($230 OT), 4-hr min + hauling both ways
Southeast.primary_url_note: Quoted via Buildermuse compilation (read 2026-10-30) citing Limehouse undated page; Limehouse listed rates also summarized there.

South Central.overtime_note: OT is +$50/hr per man (not a full crane OT rate) per North Texas sheet
South Central.source: North Texas Crane Service (Lewisville, TX) 2025 rate sheet — 40-ton w/oper. $205/hr, 4-hr min

Midwest.source: Missouri Crane Rates PDF — 40 Ton Hydraulic Boom Truck Crane $240.00/hr DAILY (includes Certified Union Operating Engineer), updated May 2025

Mountain.source: Streamline Crane Service (Wellington, CO) — 45-ton National NTC45-127 $220/hr portal-to-portal as of Jan 1, 2025 (nearest published class to 40-ton in Mountain West)
Mountain.estimate_reason: Sheet is 45-ton, not exactly 40-ton; used as Mountain regional proxy.

West Coast.source: Dependable Crane (Sacramento, CA) pricing page — 40-ton $285/hr, 2-hr min

alt_source.source: EquipMap listing — 40 Ton Straight Boom Crane Truck From $2,600/day including operator on 8hr working day
alt_source.note: Marketplace from-price; not used as regional default (higher than Dependable). Shown for range.

Northeast.derived: midpoint of published 40-ton class range $1,600–$2,600 across SE/TX/CA sheets
Northeast.source: No primary Northeast 40-ton operated sheet found in this research pass. Midpoint ESTIMATE from Buildermuse 40-ton class $200–$285/hr (→ ~$1,600–$2,280/8hr) and EquipMap from-$2,600/day.
Northeast.estimate_reason: No named Northeast rate sheet located; do not treat as a quote.

crm_reference.name: Lee Nash, Certified Crane (Beaufort, SC)
crm_reference.note: CRM transport-calculator note Oct 12: usually about the $5,500 range per set depending on site. This is a modular SET package reference, NOT a day rate — shown separately for comparison.
crm_reference.source: Embedded CRM vendor note (TQ_CRANE / Vendors outreach Oct 2026)
